rationale: After breaking through the prior session low of $106.74 to reach $106.17 (1.02% MFE), the stock failed to sustain downward momentum and has fully retraced the move back above both our entry price ($107.26) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($107.07). Because the short thesis relied on the 5-minute 9-EMA acting as dynamic overhead resistance during the breakdown, reclaiming this level signals a failed breakdown and warrants exiting near breakeven rather than risking a full stop-out at $107.75. While the bounce has reclaimed short-term moving averages, diminishing 1-minute volume and strong overhead resistance at session VWAP ($108.41) make flipping to long unattractive.
